go-kalshi v0.1.3

- Added a "Finding endpoints and types" section to the documentation with instructions for discovering generated APIs using go doc and links to online docs.
- Specified the license as MIT in the skill manifest.
- Removed the requirement for environment variables for key configuration from the skill manifest metadata (now only Go is required).
- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Documentation improvements for discoverability and onboarding; no API or code changes.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md.
- No user-facing features or breaking changes introduced.
- Documentation and usage remain unchanged.

go-kalshi 0.1.1

- Initial release of the unofficial Go client for Kalshi markets and accounts.
- Provides typed REST API client (package kalshi) with response structs and endpoint methods.
- Adds WebSocket streaming support for real-time market data (kalshiws, kalshiperpsws).
- Includes request and handshake signing (kalshiauth) using API key and private key from environment.
- Suitable for Go projects needing to fetch Kalshi market data, manage accounts, or stream market/order events.
